newsitem.title: USA: Stocks tumble on HP earnings, rate jitters.
newsitem.headline: Stocks tumble on HP earnings, rate jitters.

text.p: Stocks tumbled on Friday, with the Dow Jones industrial average losing 138 points a day after jumping to its 19th record so far this year.

Weak earnings from Hewlett-Packard and worries about Tuesday's Federal Reserve meeting on interest rates hurt the market. Based on early and unofficial data, the Dow lost 138.88 points to close at 7,194.67. Declining issues led advances by a 7-5 margin in the broader market on heavy volume of about 489 million shares on the New York Stock Exchange.
